verdict.rationale: Fastmail exposes JMAP at api.fastmail.com, and JMAP lets a client batch query, fetch and send method calls into one HTTP request, so a programmatic agent can chain operations over many items in one roundtrip. The evidence does not explicitly document bulk updates, moves or deletes across many messages. A community user also reports that filters cannot be applied to existing emails, a limitation on bulk processing. Missing for 10: explicit documentation of multi-item bulk set/move/delete operations, a UI-level bulk-action feature, the ability to apply rules retroactively, and hands-on corroboration of bulk operations at scale.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can perform bulk operations across many items at once

citations.quote: POST a `methodCalls` array. Query, fetch, and send, all in one HTTP request.
The JMAP session resource can be found at https://api.fastmail.com/jmap/session
